mechanism: Both agents lower intraocular pressure through different mechanisms (carbonic anhydrase inhibition vs. alpha-2 adrenergic agonism), and concurrent use may cause additive ocular hypotensive effects with potential for excessive IOP reduction or systemic absorption effects.
action: Monitor intraocular pressure closely during concurrent use; both agents are commonly combined clinically but require patient monitoring for efficacy and adverse effects such as ocular irritation, systemic hypotension, or CNS effects.
